name: time-waster
description: A terminal arcade for the moments Claude is busy. Opens itself when Claude starts working and signals you when Claude is done or needs you.

autoOpen.title: Open the arcade when Claude starts working
autoOpen.description: When on, sending a prompt opens the arcade in a new Windows Terminal tab, unless it is already open.

suggestGames.title: Suggest a game that fits Claude's estimated time
suggestGames.description: When on, Claude starts each reply with a rough time estimate, and the arcade suggests a game that ends before then.
